fields.title: Current and historical SR-200 properties
fields.finding: 345 MPa is a current minimum tensile-yield transfer to compression. The 379.2 MPa and 293.6 GPa endpoint is a historical roughly 1.96 mm SR-200 sheet tuple. E and strength move together; no free modulus improvement is granted.
fields.next_evidence: Obtain present supplier compression, modulus, density and process allowables for the selected gauges and formed state.
